correctness.rationale: An exact root-deleted weighted matrix-tree determinant gives a sum-of-root-weights times total-weight power forest generating polynomial. Conditional on the ordered marked path this gives the occupied-box mixture with precisely two special endpoints; m=0 is separately the deterministic path case. The all-integer moment and expectation laws follow exactly. Their consecutive difference factors with a positive denominator and strictly decreasing cubic sign, proving global maximizers and every tie; the high-leaf tail calculation gives stochastic incomparability. The embedded finite verifier passed 20,000 exact assertions, including all Cayley trees up to eight vertices; finite checks support but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: Marked-pair distance and total leaves are canonical statistics of uniform labeled trees. Their conditional mean has a sharp nonmonotone structure on a cubic distance scale rather than the ordinary square-root distance scale, with exact infinite arithmetic tie instances. The full conditional occupancy description yields an explicit infinite family in which mean and high-tail dependence point in opposite stochastic directions. This resolves a structural comparison question for every size rather than an arbitrary parameter slice; it is not claimed that the underlying rooted-forest enumerator is novel.
